name: io.github.BartWaardenburg/kvk-mcp
title: KVK Handelsregister
description: Search and retrieve company information from the KVK (Kamer van Koophandel) API

environmentVariables.name: KVK_CACHE_TTL
environmentVariables.description: Cache time in seconds. Set 0 to disable the cache.

environmentVariables.name: KVK_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum retries for rate-limited requests. Default 3.

environmentVariables.name: KVK_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to enable: search, profiles, mutations.
